# use-nosql

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse nosql facade.

## Facade links

- Canonical facade crate page: https://rustuse.org/use-nosql/
- Facade overview page: https://rustuse.org/facades/use-nosql/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-nosql/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-nosql
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-nosql/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-nosql/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-nosql/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
